tools.name: verification_capability
tools.description: Returns what Certisyn can and cannot verify today, with the coverage fraction and the claim types no domain covers. Read this before promising a user that something is verifiable.

tools.name: resolve_determination
tools.description: Resolve the code printed on a Certisyn badge or certificate to its determination: state, policy version, claim summary by state, the sealed root and its public anchor. An unknown code is not a negative finding; treat it as undetermined.

tools.name: resolve_attestation
tools.description: Resolve a counterparty attestation code to the attestation it names and the partner that issued it.

tools.name: verify_mandate
tools.description: Before you accept an act from an agent that says it acts for someone else, resolve the mandate code it presented. Pass agent_ref (the identifier the agent presented), action (family.verb, for example payment.initiate) and, where they apply, amount, currency and counterparty (a bare hostname). Return

tools.name: verify_anchor
tools.description: Independently verify an anchored evidence root. With leaf_hash, also returns the inclusion proof so the caller can recompute it without trusting Certisyn. An unknown root is not anchored, never verified.

tools.name: registry_search
tools.description: Confirm a subject you already hold a name for. This is a resolver, not a directory: it returns only subjects that chose to be discoverable, so absence is never a finding.

tools.name: bastion_verify_credential
tools.description: Publicly verify a Bastion posture credential for a target domain or by credential id, without an account.

tools.name: compliance_snapshot
tools.description: Fetch the sealed snapshot of anchored verification records for a named compliance period, as a regulator would. Deterministic for a sealed period.

tools.name: consilience_verify
tools.description: Check whether a media artefact is physically consistent with the place and time it is claimed to have been captured. Payload size is capped and calls are throttled.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "verify_mandate" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: code, agent_ref, agent_platform, action, amount, currency, counterparty
